name: Network Power [Metapsionic]
body:
You can temporarily alter the nature of certain powers to allow use over a mental link.

Prerequisites: Collective class feature, manifester level 3rd.

Benefit: To use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. You can treat a power as if it had the network descriptor. You may only use this feat on powers with a range of personal and a target of you.

Using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 4. The power’s total cost cannot exceed your manifester level.
